dct_description_sm: This project aimed to develop adaptation actions to reduce the risks associated with flooding and seasonal transportation networks by holding a series of Climate Change Adaptation Community Consultation Sessions in two First Nation communities in Northern Ontario.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Community vulnerability
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Impact assessments
dct_title_s: Climate Risks and Adaptation Planning for First Nations in Northern Ontario
